title: And every single fellow had a different way of walking.
html_source: Even from a young age, Stephen has already noted differences between himself and the people around him; he notices these differences and physically sets himself apart. This may have set him up to be ostracized later on in the novel.

anchor.text: And every single fellow had a different way of walking.
